name: Sprouting Bud
descriptionTemplate: Gain [Block:Arg1] Shield, and restore [Heal:Arg2] HP. If {Death Resistance} has been triggered in this battle, this card will take effect one additional time.
lore:
No seed fails to yearn for sprouting.
Plants bask in sunlight and rain, breaking through the soil, just as children grow up nurtured by love and hope.
Faint curls up in the cradle, holding precious nutrients, quietly awaiting that moment to arrive...
